blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas Grid will be once again placed under a yellow alert on Friday, Nov. 27, according to the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). In an advisory, the NGCP said the alert status will take effect from 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. As of Friday morning, the grid has an available capacity of 2,500 megawatts (MW), while its peak demand could reach 2,428 MW.
